subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: What permanent contract should supported config mutations use to expose JSON5 comment-loss diagnostics to machine-readable and plugin callers?
rationale: The current optional warning string is additive but becomes part of exported plugin/config mutation API behavior; repository policy requires owner intent rather than allowing an incidental test-facing string to define that contract.

options.title: Adopt typed diagnostics
options.body: Expose a stable diagnostic code and message through the public mutation result, consume it in supported CLI output, and document focused compatibility behavior.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Remove the public result fields and deliver the warning only through an internal CLI or logging path, accepting that quiet third-party callers receive no structured signal.

options.title: Accept the string field
options.body: Explicitly sponsor warning?: string as the additive public contract and require supported-command and compatibility proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt typed diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose a stable diagnostic code and message through the public mutation result, consume it in supported CLI output, and document focused compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config-write and mutation history makes steipete the strongest available owner for deciding the exported contract.
